label: Couchbase Server user
type: an identity that authenticates to Couchbase Server and holds RBAC roles, in either the local or the external authentication domain. Distinct from capella:organization members and from sgw:* identities.
note: Recurrence 5. Carries a Community Edition constraint with no Capella analogue at all - CE caps the number of users, an edition-gated limit that is meaningful for Server and structurally absent for Capella, which has no Community/Enterprise split.
